metadata.title: Micron Stock: It Faces New Memory-Chip Threat in U.S.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Faces Competition to Be the American Memory-Chip Champion
Micron Technology has been the flag-bearer for the U.S. in the memory-chip boom. But Intel and SK Hynix look to have their own American ambitions.
